notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.9 Eclipse Verb — reverb restored - Fixed the bundled Eclipse Verb: the wet signal was running roughly 15 dB too quiet, so the plugin sounded like it had almost no reverb and the tail vanished in a fraction of a second. The wet path is now level-matched, so the reverb is full and present, with a proper tail — and the space and early reflections come through.
